cases.name: move-retarget-inbound
cases.notes: §6: `retarget_inbound` rewrites the deepest hit block per inbound link as one follow-up api changeset (`retarget inbound links a.md -> moved/a.md`); `dangling` is then empty.

cases.name: delete-pools-nothing
cases.notes: §6 + §10 Pinned: one api commit `delete <path>`, blocks and doc tombstoned with it, the file removed — and NO resurrection_pool rows.
